'''Jason Foss Foss HD''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Jason Foss]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-21622">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/21622 Foss HD], DeckTech (Jason "jade" Foss, 21 February 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/21622/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/21622/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261015151222/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/21622/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Jason Foss]]
* '''Published:''' 21 February 2002 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Foss HD''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif|label=Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}

* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 HD Foss DS 2002 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' This is the solid HD deck that i will never stop playing.
